resources.string: Accept the background downloads notice in Transfers first.
Background downloads are off. Turn them on in Transfers or in Settings › Torrents and downloads.
You can turn background downloads off at any time in Settings › Torrents and downloads. With Wi-Fi only on, nothing downloads in the background on mobile data.
